PZZ700-182015-
1221 AM PDT Sun Oct 18 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 AM, a 1027 mb high was centered approximately 515 miles west
of the CA/OR border over the Pacific Ocean, and a 1013 mb low was
located over the Napa Valley area in central California. Weak 
offshore flow is expected through this early morning, with 
onshore flow returning by later day and onward, but may briefly 
turn weakly offshore again tonight. Southerly flow will increase 
Wednesday as a weather system arrives. 

$$
